scope: EventBus worker database-connection lifecycle and retry behavior
verified: A new EventBus is constructed for each worker iteration and closed afterward.
Event-store and notification database connections use a five-second connection timeout.
A failed event-store connection is logged and a later poll obtains a new bus.
A notification database failure closes the current bus and retries with fresh bounded-timeout connections.
Nonpositive polling intervals fail before opening the event store.
limitations: Checks use fault injection; no event or notification PostgreSQL restart was run.
Handler lease recovery, idempotent external delivery, and provider outage acceptance remain open.
Candidate and legacy databases were not accessed.
